results.explanation:
Grounding: every number in the report can be found in the tool results. These include 335, 327, 15.9, symmetry 0.9956, 0.134x depth, -0.9375 ticks, OTR 17.57, cancel ratio 0.94, 995.7 ms, 670/492, round trip 1.82, post-cancel move 2.5 and 2506. The E5 order IDs, quantities and times also match the tape. CLOSE_FP rests on market making, which is supported by the profile (registered MM on SYN.A, typical size 327), by two-sided simultaneous cancels at symmetry ~1 and by no favourable move or reversion. That broadly fits the closure standard.

Weaknesses:
(1) Indicator vocabulary. 'Opposite-side execution before the cancel' is listed as not matched, yet the discriminators show 492 of opposite-side BUY fills (10:52:47.066, 10:53:13.065), and the alert itself was triggered by SELL fills followed by BUY cancels. The report should have said this is present but meaningless for two-sided quoting, as the procedures state. It also never explains why same_side_fill_qty_before_opposite_trade = 0 is irrelevant here. It does not address the positive 1.82-tick round trip as ordinary spread income, or the 2.5-tick post-cancel move.
(2) Clarity. The triggering sequence is never laid out, so a reviewer must reconstruct it from the tape. That sequence is the SELL O-00009311 fills of 51 at 10:53:45.787 and 174 at 10:53:46.748, then the BUY O-00009310 cancel at 10:53:50.000.
(3) Explanations. 'Market making: supported' cites no evidence IDs. 'Order modification after a partial fill' is ruled out by E6 (fills on both sides), which does not address it. Ruling out stop-out via E3 and fat finger via E5 are reasonable.

With several points weak, the score falls in the middle band.
results.label: Adequate
